name: ND Project Brief
instructions: Use project_brief to inspect Git status changes, check project tasks in .project-brief/tasks.json, identify blocked work, and generate deterministic next actions. Use project_brief_export to generate clean Markdown summaries for standups and handoffs. Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/extension/mcp-server.mjs with the actual absolute path to mcp-server.mjs on your system.
